description_en: Calls the DescribeProjectMeta operation to query the list of cloud services that support time series monitoring metrics in CloudMonitor
description_zh: 调用DescribeProjectMeta接口查询云监控支持的时序类监控项产品列表
name: DescribeProjectMeta

parameters.help_en:
The tags. Tags are used to filter alerts, and each alert can be marked with special tags.

Currently, only filtering by product is supported. That is, the `name` is `product`. For example: {"name":"product","value":"ECS"}.
We do not recommend that you use the special tags for the CloudMonitor console in Alibaba Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
标签。根据标签过滤，标签为每个报警增加特殊标记。

目前仅支持按照产品过滤，即`name`为`product`的过滤方式，例如：{"name":"product","value":"ECS"}。
对于阿里云中云监控控制台的特殊标签，不建议您使用

Labels.description_en:
The tags. Tags are used to filter alerts, and each alert can be marked with special tags.

For example, the tags indicate the specification of the product to which the alert belongs, and whether the alert can be set. Format: `[{"name":"Tag name","value":"Tag value"}、{"name":"Tag name","value":"Tag value"}]`. The following common tags are supported:

alertUnit: the unit of the alert.
  To prevent the unit of the original reported data from being too small, which causes the value entered in an alert rule to be too large, the `alertUnit` tag is added. Currently, this tag is mainly applied to the CloudMonitor console.

minAlertPeriod: the minimum reporting period. The time interval at which monitoring data is reported. The default value is 1 minute.

metricCategory: the specification of the product. For example, kvstore_sharding.
  Some Alibaba Cloud products have different specifications that are defined in the same namespace, and this parameter is used to distinguish them.

is_alarm: indicates whether alert rules can be set.
  We do not recommend that you use the special tags for the CloudMonitor console in Alibaba Cloud
Labels.description_zh:
标签。根据标签过滤，标签为每个报警增加特殊标记。

例如：报警所属产品的规格，是否能设置告警，格式：`[{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"}、{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"}]`。常用的标签如下：

alertUnit：报警的单位。
  为了避免原始上报数据的单位过小，而导致告警规则输入的值过大而增加的`alertUnit`标签，目前主要应用于云监控控制台。

minAlertPeriod：最小上报周期。上报监控数据的时间间隔，通常为1分钟。

metricCategory：产品的规格。例如： kvstore_sharding。
  部分阿里云产品分不同规格，定义在同一个namespace中，用该参数进行区分。

is_alarm：能否设置告警规则。
  对于阿里云中云监控控制台的特殊标签，不建议您使用

Namespace.description_en: The namespace that is used to distinguish products. Format: `acs_Service abbreviation`. For more information, see [Appendix 1: Metrics]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html）
Namespace.description_zh: 命名空间，用于区分产品。格式：`acs_产品缩写`，详情请参见[云产品监控项]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values: true and false. The value true indicates success, and the value false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。true表示成功，false表示失败
